name: dcr-sicily-cars
description: DCR Sicily Cars - Car dealership website

scripts.build: vite build && cp -r data dist/data && cp -r js dist/js && cp -r admin/js dist/admin/js && cp -r admin/css dist/admin/css && cp dist/pages/404.html dist/404.html && cp -r assets/images dist/assets/images && cp -r assets/icons dist/assets/icons
scripts.deploy: npm run build && wrangler pages deploy dist --branch production
scripts.deploy:preview: npm run build && wrangler pages deploy dist --branch preview
